selected_problem: Fresh main ranked equal-scored federated proposals using default-locale String.localeCompare on provider and role. Equivalent proposals could therefore select different winners on hosts with different default locales.
route_basis: After workspace, repository-context, and semantic ranking locale dependence were closed, the same directly reproducible host bias remained at the proposal winner boundary. The fix preserves the existing scoring and consensus architecture.
change: Replace default-locale provider/role tie-breakers with deterministic code-unit lexical comparison.
truth_boundary: This closes host-locale dependence only for equal-scored federated proposal provider/role tie-breakers. It does not claim optimal proposal scoring, consensus correctness for all adversarial cases, parser-grade repository semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
